Ladder at 16 bits (finished cells only): log2 madds on log2 |F|: slope 11.031 [11.009, 11.053] over 6 points. T_dec(b) grows as |F|^slope; with |F| = p^(1/4) the p-exponent is slope/4 (threshold 0.25, i.e. slope 1). At w = 0 the cost is zero GAE (F4 performs no group operation), so the exponent is undefined there.
